column1: # Lexeme class `time_noun` (docs/LEXICON_FORMAT_ES.md §9 in the engine repo): nouns that name a point
# or span of time and head time adverbials without a preposition. Rules: `[class=time_noun]`,
# Values: weekday, month, daytime, season, unit, occasion, period, holiday.
# Written from own knowledge of Spanish (clean-room); only lemmas of this lexicon.
